title: fix(plugin-detail): record:related_list stops requiring `columns`, so the page compile accepts a node that lists none (objectui#11613)
body:
Fixes #11613
Clause-②: yes

## What changes

The `record:related_list` registration in `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (`ComponentRegistry.register('related_list', …)`) no longer declares `required: true` on its `columns` input. The input's description now says where the columns come from when the key is absent. The ledger row `record:related_list.columns` in objectui#11605's enumeration pin is deleted, so that pin now covers this member like the others.

This is triage's first grade on the card (comment `5980741977`), under objectui#11605's ruling (a): the spec row `ComponentPropsMap['record:related_list'].columns` is optional, and the registration may not be stricter than the row it publishes. The spec row's own describe says what an omitted list means: "Optional: when omitted, columns derive from the related object's highlightFields / default list columns".

No new manifest vocabulary, no new compile rule, no runtime change. `packages/types`, `sdui-parser` and the renderer are not edited. Landing site as dispatched: the registration in `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`, the ledger row, and tests beside them.

## Accept-set changes (for the contract review)

Measured against the manifest the console ships: `emitSduiManifest` over `dev/manifest-registry.ts`, read back from the written `sdui.manifest.json`. "Before" is the registration with `required: true` (base `2abec3a`, re-measured on this branch by ablation 1 below); "after" is this head. Nodes are written as JSON keys here; the pins write the same nodes as JSX.

| `type: "record:related_list"` node with | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `dataSource: { object, view }`, no `columns` | `ok: false`, one `missing-required-prop` error naming `columns` | `ok: true`, no diagnostics, the binding recorded |
| `objectName`, `relationshipField`, no `columns`, no binding | `ok: false`, the same error | `ok: true`, no diagnostics |
| `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `dataSource: { object }` (no view), no `columns` | `ok: false`, the same error | `ok: true`, no diagnostics |
| `objectName`, `relationshipField`, `columns`, `dataSource: { object, view }` (control) | `ok: true` | the same |
| `objectName`, `columns`, no `relationshipField` (control) | refused, one error naming `relationshipField` | the same |
| `relationshipField`, `columns`, no `objectName`, bound by `dataSource: { object }` or not (control) | refused, one error naming `objectName` | the same; the spec row requires it |

**What the accept set gains:** exactly the nodes that omit `columns` and carry everything else the gate already required (`objectName` and `relationshipField`), with or without a `dataSource` binding.

**What stays refused:** a node without `objectName`, bound or not, and a node without `relationshipField`.

**Unchanged, and not refusals before or after:** a `columns` value of the wrong kind (a number or a string) draws a `type-mismatch` warning with `ok: true`; a spec-legal column object draws a `member-type-mismatch` warning with `ok: true` (Acceptance notes). Neither check reads `required`.

## What a columns-less node draws (measured, not assumed)

Triage's premise, that the neither node auto-derives its columns, is now a measurement. `RecordRelatedListRenderer.columnsOptional-11613.test.tsx` renders through the real renderer, the real `ElementDataSourceGate`, the real `RelatedList` and the real table, and reads header and body cells:

- The neither node draws columns derived from the related object (`Subject`, `Status`, `Priority`, and not the foreign key back to the parent). This holds unbound and bound by object alone. No hint, no blank, no throw.
- The view-bound node draws the view's columns only (`Subject`).
- Authored `columns` win over the view and over the derivation.

## Who reads the registration's `required` for this input

Enumerated by grepping non-test sources for reads of `required` off registration or manifest `inputs`:

- `@object-ui/sdui-parser` `validateTree`, the `missing-required-prop` check (`input.required && !(input.name in node)`). It is the page compile and its `ok`, the save gate. It now accepts the nodes above.
- `@object-ui/components`' page renderer, the `kind: 'html'` page compile (`manifestFromConfigs` over the live registry). The same validator at render time, so the same widening. Source reading, not separately measured.
- `@object-ui/sdui-parser` codegen. `generateDts` now writes `columns?: string[]` on `RecordRelatedListProps`, and `generateBlockList`'s required column for the tag reads `objectName, relationshipField`. Measured once on this branch by a throwaway probe, not committed.
- Downstream: the objectstack tools that load the shipped `sdui.manifest.json` (the CLI's `compile`, `lint` and `validate`, and `metadata-protocol`'s runtime authoring gate) inherit the widening when the next console manifest ships. Not measured here.
- Studio's designer and the AI prompt keys: no reader of the registration's `required` found. `check:prompt-keys` reads the key bullets in `.github/prompts/**`, not `required`, and no prompt teaches `columns` as required.

## Generated artifacts

`sdui.manifest.json`, `sdui-intrinsics.d.ts` and `sdui-blocks.md` are not tracked: no tracked file has those names, and the positive control `apps/console/scripts/emit-sdui-manifest.ts` is tracked. They regenerate from the registration in the console build, as for objectui#11605. This diff has no regeneration step.

## Pins

- New `apps/console/src/__tests__/related-list-columns-optional-11613.test.ts`, 7 rows, judged against the shipped manifest:
  - The published `columns` is not required, and its description names `dataSource` and `highlightFields`. `objectName` and `relationshipField` stay required.
  - The view-bound node, the neither node, and the neither node bound by object alone each compile `ok` with no diagnostic.
  - Three controls: authored columns beside a view; no `relationshipField`; no `objectName`, bound or not.
- New `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordRelatedListRenderer.columnsOptional-11613.test.tsx`, 5 rows, as described above.
- `apps/console/src/__tests__/objectname-binding-required-11605.test.ts`: the `LEDGER` is now empty and says why. Its stale-row check stays, so a future row is still judged.

**Ablations** on the committed fix (`0624118`), through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The console project aliases `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/sdui-parser` to `src`, so a mutation reaches the tests without a build.

1. `required: true` put back on `columns` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx`, blob `62fba905fb9f` became `23df5500cb78`), with the two console files run. Exactly 5 rows went red and 50 passed. Red: the enumeration row for `record:related_list` (its message names `"columns"`), the published-input row, and the three columns-less compile rows, each with a `missing-required-prop` naming `columns`. Every control stayed green.
2. `RelatedList`'s derivation switched off (the `if (!objectSchema?.fields) return [];` guard made unconditional in `RelatedList.tsx`, blob `3c5bbfc1b87d` became `e5a0270e381b`), with the render file run. Exactly the 2 neither-node rows went red and 3 passed.

Each restore is proven by the tool: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The render rows need no "before" run: the runtime is not changed, and they read triage's premise.

## Gates

Final head `305c738`, which merges `main` at `6e9090c`. Every run below is on that head, from the repo root.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`, run as two path-scoped halves to stay under the foreground time cap. `src/__tests__/`: 149 files passed, 1 skipped; 1335 tests passed, 8 skipped. `src/renderers/`, `src/synth/` and the 7 top-level test files: 86 files, 991 tests passed. The 236 files are all of the package's tracked test files.
- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/`, as two halves. `src/__tests__/`: 51 files, 880 tests passed. The rest: 97 files, 888 tests passed. The 148 files are all of the console's tracked test files.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0, after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/console^...'` rebuilt the dependency closure on this head. `--listFiles`, run once before the merge, shows the new render test is in the test program.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`): exit 0. Its tsconfig includes `src`, so the new console test is in the program.
- Lint, narrowed to the 4 touched code files with `eslint --format json`: 4 files, 0 errors, 34 warnings. `index.tsx` carries 32, the same as at base `2abec3a` read through `--stdin`. The new render test carries 2 `no-explicit-any`, the pattern its sibling `redactedDerivation-9053` test uses. The narrowing is a measurement because: each file is linted by the root `eslint.config.js` (`--print-config` exit 0 for each); the count comes from the JSON output; and `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`), and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Root checks, each exit 0: `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:prompt-keys`, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only), `check:unreferenced-sources`.

CI runs the full farm.

## Changeset

`.changeset/11613-plugin-detail-related-list-columns-optional.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `minor`, with the widening paragraph opening `**Clause-②: yes (widening)**`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The member kind on `columns`.** Measured on this head: a spec-legal column object (`{ field, label }`) compiles `ok: true` with a `member-type-mismatch` warning, because the registration declares `of: 'string'` while the spec row admits string or `ListColumn` members. This is already recorded in-tree as a gap, in `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts`'s `record:related_list.columns` entry. This PR does not change it.
- **A real producer of the neither node.** The platform's own default-record-page synthesizer (`buildDefaultPageSchema` in this package, fed by app-shell's `deriveRelatedLists`) emits `record:related_list` nodes with no `columns` whenever the foreign key declares no `relatedListColumns`. Whether such a node ever reached the save gate was not measured.
- **The dispatch brief's churn note.** It said PR objectui#11612 last touched both files. Measured: that PR touched the enumeration pin only. `packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx` was last changed by objectui#11531 (`6158e4c`).
- **Docs.** The binding doc's paragraph on the `objectName` exception stays true. No doc or README says `columns` is required (grep over `content/docs` and the package README), so no doc edit is owed.
